specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Raspberry Pi® CM4, CM4 Lite; Quad Cortex-A72 at 1.5GHz

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0 Host, 1 x USB Type-C OTG

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS232, up to 4 x RS232

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS485, these 2 x RS485 can be configured as 2 x RS232

specs.name: GPIO
specs.value: Option 1: 4 x input, 4 x output from expander IC (optical isolated, DEFAULT).  Option 2: 6 x CM4 CPU GPIO (conflict with option 1).

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: Supported but depending on the CM4 selected

specs.name: ZIGBEE
specs.value: Onboard Zigbee module, not mounted by default

specs.name: Camera
specs.value: Yes, not mounted by default. Available on the board in the embedded PC.  Requires a customized case to be exposed in an enclosed PC.
